question: Does a market-structure return source (funding, relative value, settlement timing) survive assumed costs on DEV data only?
universe_note: the 15 alts of the uploaded alts bundle with data from 2021-01; HYPE and SUI excluded (listed later). BTC and ETH not used at all.

S2.use: reported only, never used to choose

never_read: BTC validation/locked TEST + embargo, all symbols
missing_bars: never filled; a symbol-day whose open (or the next open) is missing is flat that day
decision_timing: signals use only information before the bar/open where the trade is executed

cost.perp: assumed_public_v1 (taker 5bp + half spread 2bp + slippage 3bp + 0.1*sqrt(10k USDT / traded value of the 15m bar before execution)), every side
cost.spot_leg_for_cash_and_carry: ASSUMED: Binance spot base taker 10bp + half spread 2bp + slippage 3bp + same impact term on the perp bar volume (spot volume not in the data: understates impact)
cost.funding: actual settled funding from the data, paid/received on every held perp position

CC.what: cash-and-carry funding harvest: long spot + short perp, 1 unit notional per symbol, portfolio = mean over symbols with data
CC.limit: no spot or quarterly prices in the data and Binance hosts are blocked here: basis P&L is NOT measured and set to 0, so CC numbers are an upper bound on funding income after costs, not a backtest

configs.rule: per symbol: in when mean of last 3 settled rates > 1e-4, out when < 0 (hysteresis), decided at 00:00 open
top 3 by mean of last 21 settled rates (7 days), only if > 0, weekly

XC.what: perp-only cross-sectional carry on the 15-symbol universe: short the 5 highest funding, long the 5 lowest, dollar neutral (Track B tried k=2 of 6 symbols; this is the broad-universe version)

PR.what: pairs relative value (Gatev distance method + OLS hedge): every 30 days pick the N pairs with the smallest sum of squared differences of normalised log prices over the past F days; spread = log a - beta log b (beta, mean, sd from formation only); enter when |z| > z_in on day d open, executed at the d+1 open; exit when z crosses 0 or at period end; legs sized 1/(1+|beta|) and beta/(1+|beta|)

FT.what: funding-settlement timing on 15m bars: at each settlement T, if the last settled rate (known before T) > thr go short, < -thr go long (against the crowded side); windows pre [T-60m, T), straddle [T-15m, T+15m) (receives/pays the funding at T), post [T, T+60m); per-symbol events, daily sum, equal weight over symbols
FT.configs: window in {pre, straddle, post} x thr in {1e-4, 3e-4} = FT1..FT6

statistics: annualised Sharpe of daily portfolio returns (net of cost and funding) in S1; DSR with N=22 and with N=22+3919 (strong-search Track A 3857 + Track B 62 on the same days, one family); 5 folds; S2 and 2x cost reported for every config; correlation with the equal-weight long portfolio of the universe
bar_for_interesting: unchanged from the project: DSR >= 0.95 at the family-wide N and positive S1 folds; nothing here is a validation and nothing is promoted
not_done: basis (spot vs perp, quarterly futures) cannot be measured with the data available; recorded as untested
